notes.title: Update Complete Notice
notes.content: [p]Thank you for your patience.[/p][p]Today, we have completed bug fixes, improvements to problematic areas, and the addition of new features for “Monativity Surveillance”.[/p][p]The update details are as follows:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Fixed input errors for certain phrases during typing[/p][/*][*][p]Improved flexibility in typing input[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed UI issues during anomaly occurrences[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the elapsed time during typing[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the game over process[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the anomaly occurrence mechanism[/p][/*][*][p]Added a skip function for problems[/p][/*][*][p]Added additional text to some explanations[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Regarding the skip function for problems, we have also added an explanation within the game.[/p][p]We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused.[/p][p]If you encounter any mistakes in the typing problems or input errors, we would appreciate it if you could let us know.[/p]
